statement_record.book: Theorem 1: for any small graph G there is a category C and a graph morphism P : G -> UC such that any graph morphism D : G -> UB into (the underlying graph of) any category B factors as U D' ∘ P = D for a UNIQUE functor D' : C -> B; if D is an O-graph morphism then D' is the identity on objects.
statement_record.intree: UniversalArrowQuiverCat : @UniversalArrow QuiverCategory StrictCat G Forgetful — for every category C and quiver homomorphism F : G ⇨ U C, InducedFunctor F factors F through the unit up to StrictCat equality, uniquely; packaged further as FreeForgetfulAdjunction : FreeCatFunctor ⊣ Forgetful.

The identity-on-objects tail is definitional: InducedFunctor's object map IS D's node map, so it is the identity when D's is.
